title: Why Cancer Rates Are Rising Among Younger Adults
subtitle: New international data shows a concerning trend for people under 50, but experts say we need to look beyond the numbers.

summary.en: Recent research from the World Cancer Research Fund shows that cancer rates are increasing among people under 50. While these diseases remain rare in younger age groups, the rise is being seen in many countries worldwide. Experts are investigating links between these trends and lifestyle factors like diet and obesity. Better detection methods may explain some of the increase, but scientists believe other causes are likely at work. Governments are now being urged to take stronger action to improve public health.
summary.zh: 世界癌症研究基金會的最新研究顯示，五十歲以下族群的癌症發生率正在上升。儘管這些疾病在年輕族群中仍屬罕見，但全球許多國家皆觀察到此趨勢。專家正調查這些趨勢與飲食、肥胖等生活型態因素之間的關聯。更好的檢測方法或許能解釋部分增長，但科學家認為還有其他原因在起作用。目前各界正敦促政府採取更強有力的行動，以改善公共衛生。

paragraphs.en: New data from the World Cancer Research Fund (WCRF) has confirmed a worrying trend: cancer rates are rising among people under the age of 50. While a cancer diagnosis is difficult at any age, it is particularly shocking for younger adults who are generally expected to be in good health. This global trend has been observed in countries including England, the United States, and the Netherlands, leading health experts to search for the underlying causes.
paragraphs.zh: 世界癌症研究基金會（World Cancer Research Fund, WCRF）的最新數據證實了一項令人擔憂的趨勢：五十歲以下族群的癌症發生率正在上升。雖然在任何年齡層確診癌症都很艱難，但對於普遍被認為身體健康的年輕成人來說，這尤其令人震驚。這種全球趨勢已在英國、美國和荷蘭等國家觀察到，促使健康專家開始尋找背後的根本原因。

paragraphs.en: According to the WCRF, the number of new cases for seven different types of cancer has increased in England alone. Among these, colorectal cancer—also known as bowel cancer—has seen a significant rise. In 2001, about one in every 26,000 people under 50 in England was diagnosed with this disease. By 2023, that number had doubled to one in every 12,000. Other cancers, such as those affecting the breast, kidney, and uterus, are also becoming more common in younger populations.
paragraphs.zh: 根據世界癌症研究基金會的資料，僅在英國，七種不同癌症的新增病例數皆有所增加。其中，大腸癌（亦稱為腸癌）的增幅顯著。二〇〇一年時，英國五十歲以下人口中，約每兩萬六千人就有一人確診此病；到了二〇二三年，該數字已翻倍至每一萬兩千人就有一人。其他如乳癌、腎臟癌和子宮癌等，在年輕族群中也變得越來越常見。

paragraphs.en: However, experts advise that we should not panic. Amy Berrington de Gonzalez, a professor of clinical epidemiology at the Institute of Cancer Research in London, noted that cancer is still very uncommon among young people. She explained to Deutsche Welle that even though rates have doubled, the total number of cases remains small. She added that scientists are still trying to determine if we are seeing a true rise in the number of people getting sick, or if we are simply getting better at finding these cancers early through improved screening and awareness.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，專家建議我們不必恐慌。倫敦癌症研究所（Institute of Cancer Research）的臨床流行病學教授貝林頓·德·岡薩雷斯（Amy Berrington de Gonzalez）指出，癌症在年輕人中仍然非常罕見。她向德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）解釋，儘管發生率翻倍，但病例總數依然偏低。她補充說，科學家仍在釐清我們觀察到的是罹病人數的真實增加，還是僅僅因為篩檢與意識的提升，讓我們能更早發現這些癌症。

paragraphs.en: While better detection is a factor, researchers believe it is not the only reason for the increase. Many scientists are now looking closely at lifestyle factors. Marc Gunter, a professor of cancer epidemiology at Imperial College London, told Deutsche Welle that as diets become more "Westernized"—meaning higher in processed foods and sugar—and lifestyles become more inactive, we should expect to see these trends continue in many parts of the world. Research from other regions, such as Latin America, supports this view, with countries like Chile and Brazil reporting higher numbers of early-onset cases.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然檢測技術的進步是一個因素，但研究人員認為這並非增加的唯一原因。許多科學家目前正密切關注生活型態因素。倫敦帝國學院（Imperial College London）的癌症流行病學教授岡特（Marc Gunter）告訴德國之聲，隨著飲食變得更加「西化」（意指加工食品與糖分攝取量增加），加上生活型態變得更加缺乏運動，我們預期這些趨勢將在世界許多地區持續下去。來自拉丁美洲等其他地區的研究也支持此觀點，智利和巴西等國皆回報了較高的早發性病例數。

paragraphs.en: In addition to diet, some studies suggest that biological factors play a role. A recent study published in the journal Clinical Gastroenterology and Hepatology found that "accelerated biological aging"—where the body ages faster than the actual number of years a person has lived—is linked to a much higher risk of early-onset colon cancer. This suggests that the reasons behind the rise in cancer may be complex and involve how our bodies interact with our modern environment.
paragraphs.zh: 除了飲食之外，部分研究顯示生物學因素也扮演了角色。近期發表於《臨床胃腸病學與肝臟病學》（Clinical Gastroenterology and Hepatology）期刊的一項研究發現，「加速生物老化」（即身體老化速度快於實際年齡）與早發性大腸癌的高風險有顯著關聯。這顯示癌症發生率上升背後的原因可能相當複雜，且與我們的身體如何與現代環境互動有關。

paragraphs.en: Public health experts are now calling for governments to take more decisive action. The Guardian reports that while international efforts to reduce lung cancer by targeting smoking were successful, similar efforts to fight obesity have not been as effective. Many politicians have promised to create stronger health plans to encourage better diets, but these plans are often weakened due to pressure from the food and drink industries. Scientists have even protested that governments have done very little to warn the public about the health risks of certain chemicals added to processed meats.
paragraphs.zh: 公共衛生專家現正呼籲政府採取更果斷的行動。《衛報》（The Guardian）報導指出，雖然國際間透過針對吸菸問題來減少肺癌的努力取得了成功，但對抗肥胖的類似措施卻未見同等成效。許多政治人物曾承諾制定更強而有力的健康計畫以鼓勵改善飲食，但這些計畫往往因食品與飲料產業的壓力而遭到削弱。科學家甚至抗議政府在警告大眾關於加工肉品中添加特定化學物質的健康風險方面，做得遠遠不足。

paragraphs.en: There is a fear that if these trends continue, the gap between different groups will widen. The Guardian noted that there is a strong link between obesity, poor diet, and poverty. If health policy is not handled carefully, it could lead to a situation where some people have access to better health outcomes while others face higher risks because of their socioeconomic status. Experts argue that governments must view public health as a whole, rather than just relying on hospitals to treat the symptoms of a larger problem.
paragraphs.zh: 各界擔憂若這些趨勢持續，不同群體間的差距將會擴大。《衛報》指出，肥胖、不良飲食與貧窮之間存在強烈關聯。若健康政策未經審慎處理，可能會導致部分人享有較佳的健康結果，而其他人卻因社會經濟地位而面臨更高風險。專家主張，政府必須將公共衛生視為一個整體，而非僅僅依賴醫院來治療更大問題所引發的症狀。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the focus remains on gathering more data. A new project in the UK, known as the Prospect-UK trial, is seeking 250,000 participants to study early-onset bowel cancer. This research aims to look at nutrition in much greater detail than ever before. By understanding what people are eating and how their environments affect their health, researchers hope to find ways to stop this trend. For now, the message from the medical community is clear: while we have made great progress in cancer treatment, we must be just as bold in tackling the root causes of the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，重點仍放在蒐集更多數據。英國一項名為「Prospect-UK」的新計畫，正招募二十五萬名參與者以研究早發性大腸癌。這項研究旨在比以往更深入地探討營養問題。透過了解人們的飲食內容及其環境如何影響健康，研究人員希望能找到阻止此趨勢的方法。目前，醫學界的訊息很明確：雖然我們在癌症治療上已取得巨大進展，但我們必須同樣大膽地解決疾病的根本原因。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Basic, fundamental, or hidden causes that are not immediately obvious.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常誤以為是「在下面」，這裡指隱藏在表面之下的根本原因。文中：leading health experts to search for the underlying causes.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Describing a disease that appears at a younger age than is typical.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 早發性的（指疾病在較年輕時發生）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 由 early 和 onset 組成，專指疾病在比預期更早的年紀出現。文中：with countries like Chile and Brazil reporting higher numbers of early-onset cases.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To deal with or address a difficult problem or challenge.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意指運動中的「擒抱」，這裡引申為積極處理棘手問題。文中：we must be just as bold in tackling the root causes of the disease.

quiz.question: How did the incidence rate of bowel cancer among people under 50 in England change between 2001 and 2023?

options.A: It increased from one in 12,000 to one in 26,000.
options.B: It rose from one in 26,000 to one in 12,000.
options.C: It remained stable at one in 26,000 despite higher awareness.
options.D: It doubled from 12,000 cases to 26,000 cases annually.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，2001 年的比例約為每 26,000 人中有一人，到了 2023 年該數字翻倍，變為每 12,000 人中有一人。選項 A 將數字順序顛倒；選項 C 錯誤地說數字保持穩定；選項 D 混淆了比例與總病例數，且數字邏輯錯誤。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the role of government policy in addressing the rise of early-onset cancer?

options.A: Governments have successfully prioritized public health over the interests of the food industry.
options.B: Current government strategies are highly effective at curbing obesity in the same way they reduced smoking.
options.C: Political pressure from food and drink industries often hinders the implementation of effective health regulations.
options.D: Governments are currently focusing exclusively on hospital treatments rather than preventative measures.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第六段提到，儘管政府承諾制定健康計畫，但這些計畫常因食品與飲料產業的壓力而減弱。選項 A 與文章描述的現狀相反；選項 B 錯誤，文章指出對抗肥胖的成效不如對抗吸菸；選項 D 過於絕對，雖然政府目前過於依賴醫院治療，但文章並未說政府「完全不」考慮預防措施。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'bold' mean as used in the phrase 'we must be just as bold in tackling the root causes'?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，「bold」意指在面對困難問題時展現出勇氣與果斷的行動力。選項 B 是該詞的字面意思（粗體或字體加粗），不適用於此；選項 C 與 D 皆帶有負面或不適當的語氣，與醫學界呼籲積極解決問題的正面意圖不符。

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the central message of the article?

options.A: Cancer rates among young people are rising solely due to improved medical screening technology.
options.B: The rise in early-onset cancer is a complex issue requiring a shift from reactive treatment to addressing lifestyle and environmental root causes.
options.C: Biological aging is the only proven cause of the recent increase in colon cancer cases among younger adults.
options.D: The World Cancer Research Fund believes that the increase in cancer cases is a temporary trend that will resolve itself without intervention.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章綜合討論了癌症增加的現象，並指出這涉及篩檢技術、生活型態（西方化飲食）、生物因素及政府政策等多重面向，強調必須從根本解決。選項 A 忽略了生活型態等其他因素；選項 C 將「生物老化」視為唯一原因，過於武斷；選項 D 與文章警告應採取行動的立場完全相反。
